interface.longDescription: Create and manage Japanese vocabulary flashcards in Nihontekini from ChatGPT. Build decks from a topic, JLPT level or text, look up and explain words, fix or suspend cards, check your learning progress and practice the words you keep forgetting with personalized quizzes. Cards include readings, English meanings, explanations and example sentences, and sync to the Nihontekini iOS app. Connect your Nihontekini account to start.
defaultPrompt: Add 20 N5 food words to a Kitchen deck.
Quiz me on the Japanese words I keep forgetting.
How am I doing with my Japanese this week?

name: nihontekini
description: Connect Nihontekini Japanese vocabulary decks, spaced repetition and quizzes to ChatGPT.
